_note: The pedlar's camp (sim/pedlar_camp.gd, Yusuf's pick 2026-10-21, replacing the pedlar's carousel). Every `every`-th round (3, 6, 9, 12) the build phase offers `offer` pedlars from `pedlars`, each with where it would camp; the player invites one or none (RunState.choose_pedlar). The pedlar camps at that spot for the round's days and packs up at dusk on the last day, before the attack. camp: near/middle/far, a distance from the hearth in `camps`; the spot is rolled away from the dens. slot: the kind of ware it sells (weapon, armor, charm; "" any). wares: how many it lays out, rolled as loot `ahead` rounds past this one, at least `affixes` affixes each. Heroes walk out on their own, by day, once a day: a hero goes when the camp is within camp_reach_base + (greed + wilds) x camp_reach_per of the hearth, plus guarded_reach while a guard stands at the camp. There they sell every spare item for its value x buys (the market keeps 20%, the pedlar nothing) and buy the ware that most improves their gear (by their likes), at its value x price, if they have that many shells x their hoard. The pedlar hires up to `guards` heroes whose duty or greed is at least guard_appetite (most keen first), again each dawn if one fell; guards stay by the camp day and night (sleeping rough there), fight anything within guard_radius of it, and when it packs up each takes a ware as pay, the most wanted first. Raiders and wanderers within aggro of the camp go for it; it has hp health, and if it falls the pedlar flees with the wares and the guards get nothing.
